'''Vran Tristen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vran Tristen was a leader of the Darkwalker criminals, holding the title of [[Bloodlord]], who operated from a [[Darkwalker Bunker|bunker]] in the [[Lasay Swamp]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tristen's group had stolen a valuable [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] then sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the Darkwalker bunker in order to retrieve the Gungan artifact. Several Darkwalkers, including Vran Tristen were killed during the assault.<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vran Tristen appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vran Tristen was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
